decision.why: The tightened flag, applied only where the leave-one-mix-out gate fires, improves the 19-pair mean exit error (30.7 -> 26.31) and the 5 mid-track cases (72.56 -> 55.89) with no false moves and no new hard fails on those 19. It is still a flag, off by default: official 33-pair scores were not rerun, recall is only 2/5 mid-track transitions, and JS13 (the RCA pair) still hard-fails on pumping. Do not write rules.json.
